items.title: Chipotle (CMG) Pulls Jalapeños After Minnesota Salmonella Outbreak】【。
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill removed jalapeño peppers from Minnesota locations after a Salmonella outbreak linked to its restaurants. The company is working with health authorities and has shifted to an alternative supplier for jalapeños. The incident raises fresh questions around food safety practices and potential operational disruption for NYSE:CMG.
